Swaminarayan Akshardham, Delhi ke baare mein 3 baatein.
Iska aadhar Gajendra Peeth hai, jismein patthar ke 148 haathi taraashe gaye hain.
Mandir bina steel aur concrete ke bana hai, aur 6 November 2005 ko khula tha.
अक्षरधाम की नक्काशी देखकर मन शांत हो जाता है।
Aap Akshardham kab gaye the, aur aapko sabse zyada kya pasand aaya?
